import sys

def main():
    # Debug file redirection is not needed in Python; we read from stdin.
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    if n == 1:
        x = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
        print(x)
        return
    arr = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        arr[i] = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    # Bubble sort
    for i in range(n - 1):
        for j in range(n - i - 1):
            if arr[j] > arr[j + 1]:
                temp = arr[j]
                arr[j] = arr[j + 1]
                arr[j + 1] = temp
    print(arr[(n - 1) // 2])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
